name: Thunder Axe Fortress
summary: Thunder Axe Fortress is a fortified compound in northwestern Desolace serving as a stronghold for the demonic Burning Blade cult. Within its stone barracks, watchtowers, and darkened caves, cultists perform dark rituals to summon demonic entities and store stolen artifacts of power. The cult remains an active threat to anyone traversing the desolate wastes.

sections.title: A Bastion of the Burning Blade
sections.body: Perched in northwestern Desolace, Thunder Axe Fortress serves as a heavily guarded redoubt for the Burning Blade. Composed of stone barracks, defensive watchtowers, and deep caverns, it allows the cult to maintain a fortified foothold far from the gaze of Kalimdor's major cities. Here, the cultists gather fel energies, summon lesser demons, and concoct schemes to bring far more dangerous entities into the world.

sections.title: Stolen Relics and Dark Summonings
sections.body: The cult stores the Hand of Iruxos at the fortress, a relic linked to the demonic portals of Mannoroc Coven. A Burning Blade seer also studies the stolen Sceptre of Light atop one of the watchtowers. Azore Aldamort asks travelers to recover the sceptre, which is rumored to have been taken from the naga.

aliases: who is in thunder axe fortress
faq.answer: The fortress is held by the Burning Blade cult, an organization devoted to demonic power and the remnants of the Shadow Council. On the ground, the fortress and its operations are overseen by warlocks such as Tyranis Malem.

faq.q: What is the Sceptre of Light?
faq.answer: The Sceptre of Light is an ancient artifact said to be able to sink entire cities beneath the sea. Azore Aldamort asks travelers to retrieve it from a Burning Blade seer studying it atop one of the fortress's watchtowers.

faq.q: How is this fortress connected to Mannoroc Coven?
faq.answer: The cultists at Thunder Axe Fortress hold an artifact known as the Hand of Iruxos. This relic was directly linked to the demon portals active at the Mannoroc Coven in southern Desolace, binding their demonic efforts across the zone.

angles.text: The Burning Blade's experiments at the fortress demonstrate the reckless bounds of demonology, from binding lesser fiends to forcing planar rifts for greater entities.
Investigating Thunder Axe Fortress aligns with Argent Dawn efforts to secure dangerous artifacts like the Sceptre of Light before fel cultists turn them against the continent.
